role: WebSocket gateway that registers telemetry clients for broadcasting.
detail: Thin NestJS WebSocket gateway exposing /ws/telemetry endpoint. Implements OnGatewayConnection and OnGatewayDisconnect lifecycle hooks. Delegates actual broadcast logic to TelemetryBroadcastService: handleConnection calls broadcast.addClient(client) with log, handleDisconnect calls broadcast.removeClient(client). Uses private Logger for client connection/disconnection events. No subscription handling, message routing, or state mgmt in gateway itself — pure registration layer.
